REACHABLE.reason: Executable governance is activated, but a real current construction program with artist work packages has not yet been exercised through normal operation.

RECOVERABLE.reason: No dedicated rollback/recovery exercise for the activated construction-program governance has yet been observed.

CONSUMER_ACCEPTED.reason: Automated governance proof is not Personal Production or artist acceptance.

VALUE_EVIDENCED.reason: No real-work value observation has yet been recorded for the activated construction program.

anti_collapse_rule: Passing construction and CI may prove implementation, integration, verification and authority safety only where evidence supports them. It does not imply reachability, recoverability, consumer acceptance or value evidence.
